rule_outs: Dwelling 9 m from the best section
summary: Narrow steep lane with homes 7-9 m from the west kerb.

drivers.seclusion: Houses on both sides; mapped dwellings 7 m (at 48 m) and 9 m (at 23 m) bracket this section, the rest 20 m or more.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow lane, grass verge on the west is steep and fenced, little room to pull clear.
drivers.convention: Only an occasional parked car; no sign of overnight stays.

flags: Homes within 10 m either side of the section
sun_shade: Heavy tree canopy shades the lane, mostly from the east.

best_section.where: West kerb beside the grass verge, south of the pool house
